column1: # CI slice of g1k_dosages_prs313.tsv. Real 1000 Genomes phase-3 effect-allele dosages (0/1/2) for
# the PGS000004 variants, keyed by CHROM:POS:EFFECT_ALLELE. 97 of 2504 individuals x 315 variants.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The full 2504-row matrix is deliberately gitignored: DATA_LICENSES section 4
# justifies redistributing about 30,800 genotype cells and the full matrix is 24x that. But that
# left the PRS313 loader path - now the DEFAULT for the browser and the trainer - running on a
# maintainer's machine and not in CI, while a local run reported green. A path with no CI coverage is
# a path whose next regression is found by a person, not a gate.
# The slice holds the CELL count section 4 argues for rather than the row count: 97 x 315 =
# 30,555 cells, against 400 x 77 = 30,800 for PRS77. Same redistribution budget, different
# shape, because the argument is about how much genotype data is published and not about rows.
# Source: 1000 Genomes phase 3 (IGSR), GRCh37, read by tabix range request and matched on REF/ALT
# rather than through an rsID - PGS000004 publishes none. IGSR grants NO blanket licence; rights vary
# by data component. See DATA_LICENSES.md section 4.
